providers.timingScope: dynamic provider chunk + wasm init for cold; zod normalization + SceneIR JSON serde + WebGPU render + full RGBA8 readback for render samples

reasons.cpuPreparationMs: committed adapter API exposes only end-to-end render calls; SceneIR normalization/lowering cannot be split without production instrumentation
reasons.gpuPassMs: renderSceneToPixelsGpu resolves after submit and readback; adapter exposes no timestamp-query split
reasons.readbackMs: committed pixel API combines WebGPU work and readback in one Promise; no separate readback timer is exposed

reasons.peakCpuBytes: Chromium exposes page-wide JS/user-agent memory signals, not provider-attributed native CPU peak memory; those signals are recorded separately and are not relabeled
reasons.peakGpuBytes: WebGPU exposes limits but no allocation or peak-residency query for wgpu/Vello internal resources
reasons.peakTextureBytes: provider adapter does not expose exact live texture allocation bytes and WebGPU has no portable query
reasons.peakBufferBytes: provider adapter does not expose exact live buffer allocation bytes and WebGPU has no portable query
reasons.atlasOccupancyPct: no renderer adapter in this bounded SceneIR corpus exposes atlas occupancy telemetry
reasons.atlasFragmentationPct: no renderer adapter in this bounded SceneIR corpus exposes atlas fragmentation telemetry
